essence: The design drafted live. A cyanotype drawing set where a machine or a system is drawn, measured and taken apart, sheet by sheet.
explains_by: Draw it to understand it: the drawing appears in drafting order, outline, detail, dimension.
A sheet per question: a plan, a section, a detail sheet, each answering one thing.
Measure what matters: a dimension or a reading only when the value is the point.
Take it apart: an exploded view or a section shows what is inside and how parts work together.
